subtitle: Manage upstream vendor profiles, balance credentials, console links, and recharge links in one place. Channel quota remains the site-side operational view below.
coverageNote: Only apikey/bedrock channels expose a real, admin-configured quota. Anthropic OAuth and account-pool channels have no balance API — the numbers shown for them are account-side daily-cost estimates, not balances.
degradedNote: Some sites could not be reached and are excluded from coverage counts:
noBalanceApi: No balance API for this channel type — estimate only
tableEmpty: No upstream channels found. Managed or newapi sites may not report balances.
thresholdOff: Low-balance alerting is off. Set RP_CHANNEL_BALANCE_THRESHOLD (USD) and restart to enable it for real-quota channels.
rechargeDesc: Read-only shortcuts to upstream recharge pages. Opening a link jumps to the upstream site in a new tab; top-ups are done there and reconciled manually. No quota reset or balance change is performed here.
rechargeUrlHint: Must start with http or https.
rechargeUrlInvalid: Every URL must be http or https
resetDisabledHint: Quota reset is disabled on the server. Set RP_UPSTREAM_RESET_ENABLED=1 and restart to enable it.
resetOnlyQuotaHint: Only real-quota channels have a usable quota interface
resetConfirmMessage: Irreversible: this zeroes the used-quota counter for this upstream channel, used after a top-up or renewal. It cannot be undone.
vendorSubtitle: Automatic discovery creates vendor profiles and source notes. Add balance credentials, console links, and recharge links manually; balance is one part of each vendor profile.
vendorPurposeHint: Inferred from active account platforms, model mappings, and route manifests without reading or returning API keys
vendorStaleTitle: The latest refresh failed; values are from the last successful snapshot
vendorCostPartial: Month-to-date cost covers only part of the accounts or keys
vendorEmpty: No upstream vendors discovered from managed sites
vendorFooter: {withBalance}/{total} vendors report a real balance · month-to-date upstream cost {cost} {unit} · flagged red below {days} days of runway
vendorEditDesc: Automatic discovery remains active. These fields add real-balance credentials and shortcuts. Tokens are encrypted and never returned.
vendorNoteAutoHint: Leave blank to keep the automatically discovered source note
vendorSecretKeep: Configured; leave blank to keep it
vendorUserIdRequired: Required for a real NewAPI balance
vendorSecretHint: Security: tokens are used only in server memory for read-only balance queries and encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. APIs, logs, and audit records never return plaintext.
